description:
Developer for a PeopleSoft upgrade from 9.1 to 9.2. The current implementation has many customized modules and supplemental applications that are associated with PeopleSoft. Role includes input and work and understanding of PeopleSoft code, SQL, and other coding languages. Role will have aspects related to design, build, testing, deployments, etc. Experience with previous upgrades and the SDLC is a plus. 
 
 Required Technical Skills 
 · People Code – 5+ years of experience 
 · PL/SQL – 5+ years of experience 
 · PeopleSoft Upgrade – 5+ years of experience 
 · PeopleSoft Financial – 5+ years of experience 


 *** Please share me your updated word copy of Resume. 
 *** I'll Appreciate, if you referred to someone who is looking for this position.
